name: eggd_care
title: eggd_care
summary: DNAnexus app to run the UCSC Treehouse Comparative Analysis of RNA Expression (CARE) outlier pipeline on a sample processed by eggd_treehouse_pipeline

inputSpec.name: rsem_genes_results
inputSpec.label: RSEM genes results file
inputSpec.help: rsem_genes.results file produced by eggd_treehouse_pipeline (located under RSEM/ in the expression output)

inputSpec.name: umend_qc_tsv
inputSpec.label: UMEND_QC output file in tsv format
inputSpec.help: bam_umend_qc.tsv file produced by eggd_treehouse_pipeline (located under qc/ in the qc output)

inputSpec.name: diagnosis
inputSpec.label: Harmonised diagnosis
inputSpec.help: Harmonised diagnosis of the focus sample. Must match a value in the 'disease' column of the Treehouse compendium clinical data (clinical_TumorCompendium_v10_PolyA_2019-07-25.tsv). Leave blank to skip disease-specific outlier analysis and run pan-disease only

inputSpec.name: care_source_code_tar
inputSpec.label: CARE Docker source code v0.17.1.0
inputSpec.help: DNA Nexus file for Compressed source code (.tar.gz) of the UCSC CARE pipeline. From https://github.com/UCSC-Treehouse/CARE - tag 0.17.1.0

inputSpec.name: compendium
inputSpec.label: Treehouse tumour compendium
inputSpec.help: DNA Nexus file for Treehouse tumour compendium archive (e.g. TumorCompendium_v10_PolyA.tgz). Downloaded from https://xena.treehouse.gi.ucsc.edu/download/CARE/TumorCompendium_v10_PolyA.tgz

inputSpec.name: references
inputSpec.label: CARE reference files
inputSpec.help: DNA Nexus file for CARE reference archive (e.g. TreehouseReferences-2020-03-30.tgz). Downloaded from https://xena.treehouse.gi.ucsc.edu/download/CARE/TreehouseReferences-2020-03-30.tgz

outputSpec.name: summary_html
outputSpec.label: Summary HTML report
outputSpec.help: Human-readable HTML summary of CARE outlier analysis results (Summary.html)

outputSpec.name: slides_html
outputSpec.label: Slides HTML report
outputSpec.help: Slide-format HTML report of CARE outlier analysis results (Slides.html)

outputSpec.name: output_json_files
outputSpec.label: CARE output JSON files
outputSpec.help: JSON files produced by each CARE notebook step, containing programmatic results of the outlier analysis

outputSpec.name: output_notebooks
outputSpec.label: Executed Jupyter notebooks
outputSpec.help: Executed Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) from each analysis step, for inspection and audit
